tools.name: calculate_chart
tools.description: Calculate a deterministic personal natal chart or national mundane chart using the high-precision astronomical ephemeris calculation engine. Corresponds to /chart and /mundane slash commands. Supports EITHER a country name (e.g. 'India', 'USA', 'France') for a national chart OR personal birth detail

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_horoscope" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
